tools.description: Get live USD spot prices for one or more cryptocurrencies by ticker symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL). Backed by Coinbase.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "price" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get live USD spot prices for one or more cryptocurrencies by ticker symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL). Backed by Coinbase." → after: "Get live USD spot prices for one or more cryptocurrencies by ticker symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL)."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
